text: The Taskforce is in its early stages, with formal launch and scope defined. Quantifiable sector context includes budget allocations for related initiatives, such as A$22.6 million over four years for the Hazards Insurance Partnership and A$24.3 million over five years for affordability initiatives. The Cyclone Reinsurance Pool is backed by up to A$10 billion per annum, with large insurers participating by late 2024. Taskforce-specific measured outcomes have not yet been publicly reported.
